whyItMatters: NuGet restores exactly these names, so a name that only looks like the intended package brings foreign assemblies into the build. The name this rule expects is `FluentValidation`.
actions: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `FluentValidation`, correct it to that exact spelling.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm packages.lock.json no longer carries a locked package name in packages.lock.json within one edit of `FluentValidation`.
